h1: The 7 Best BISSELL Steam Mops for Hard Floors, Pets and Tile in 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best BISSELL Steam Mops 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 BISSELL steam mops, PowerFresh, Spinwave and CrossWave, compared on steam control, vacuum combos, handheld use and price.
summary: The BISSELL PowerFresh Vac & Steam 2747A is the steam mop to buy if you hate sweeping first, because it picks up debris and steams in one pass. The PowerFresh Slim 3-in-1 is the best for handheld jobs, the Deluxe 1806 is the best-controlled steamer, and the CrossWave HydroSteam is the wet-dry flagship.
intro: BISSELL sells so many steam mops with near-identical names that the buying mistake is picking by price instead of by job. The range splits cleanly into four types: classic steam mops, steam mops with a built-in vacuum, handheld-convertible 3-in-1 units, and spin-and-steam machines. Which type you need depends on how you clean, not on how much you want to spend.

That is the logic of this ranking. We reviewed seven BISSELL models and sorted them by what each type solves: debris pickup, handheld steaming, steam control, manoeuvrability and pet odour. All judgments come from listings and spec sheets, not floor trials, and we note that steam suits sealed floors only.

products.name: Bissell PowerFresh Vac & Steam All-in-One Vacuum and Steam Mop, 2747A
products.verdict: Picks up debris and steams in one pass, which saves the sweep-first step.
products.description:
The 2747A is a vacuum and steam mop in one body, model 2747A. It picks up debris and steams the floor in a single pass, and costs $100 to $200.

The usual steam mop routine is sweep, then steam. Skipping the first step is the single biggest time saving in this range, and it also keeps grit from dragging under the pad. The compromise is body weight: a combined unit is heavier than a plain steamer.

Buy it if you want one tool for the whole floor routine. Skip it if you already own a good vacuum and want a light mop.
pros: Vacuums and steams in one pass
products.idealFor: People who want a one-tool floor routine.
products.skipIf: You prefer a light mop and a separate vacuum.

products.name: BISSELL PowerFresh Slim 3-in-1 Steam Mop and Handheld Steamer, Extension
products.verdict: A slim steam mop that detaches into a handheld, with an extension wand and tool kit.
products.description:
The PowerFresh Slim is a 3-in-1 that detaches into a handheld steamer. It comes with an extension wand and an on-board tool kit, and costs $100 to $200.

The handheld and tools extend the machine to grout, counters, stair risers and appliances. The slim body fits under furniture. It ranks second since the vacuum combo handles the main floor routine better, and this model focuses on versatility instead.

Buy it if your cleaning list includes more than floors. Skip it if you only mop.
products.idealFor: Tile, grout and counter cleaning as well as floors.

products.name: Bissell PowerFresh Deluxe 1806 Steam Mop for Tile, Hardwood and Sealed Floors
products.verdict: Variable steam levels and a built-in scrub brush with a fast 30 second warm-up.
products.description:
The Deluxe 1806 is the flagship classic steam mop in the line. It offers variable steam levels, a built-in scrub brush and a warm-up of about 30 seconds, for tile, hardwood and sealed floors. It costs $100 to $200.

Being able to lower the steam is the difference between a mop you use on wood and one you use only on tile. The scrub brush handles dried-on spots. It ranks third since the first two add pickup and handheld function that many households value more.

Buy it if you want a classic mop with the best control. Skip it if you want debris pickup.
products.idealFor: Mixed hard floors, including sealed wood.
products.skipIf: You want a vacuum or handheld.

products.name: BISSELL Spinwave SmartSteam Steam Cleaner Mop, Swivel Steering, 3897A
products.verdict: Swivel steering makes it the easiest to guide around furniture.
products.description:
The SmartSteam 3897A belongs to the Spinwave family and uses swivel steering to guide the head around table legs and chairs. It costs $100 to $200.

Steering is an underrated feature, since a mop that fights you around furniture gets used less often. It ranks fourth because the listing offers fewer specifics about steam levels and accessories than the classic units.

Buy it if your home has many furniture legs. Skip it if you want documented steam control.
products.idealFor: Furnished rooms with many legs to steer around.

products.name: BISSELL CrossWave HydroSteam 3-in-1 Wet Dry Vacuum Mop, 35151
products.verdict: A wet-dry vacuum, mop and steam in one machine, at the top of the price scale.
products.description:
The CrossWave HydroSteam is a 3-in-1 wet-dry vacuum and mop with steam, model 35151. It costs $200 to $500.

It does the most work: it sucks up dry debris and wet spills, mops, and adds steam. It ranks fifth because the price jumps a tier, the machine is bulkier, and many homes do not need all three functions. Where it earns its keep is a busy household with sticky spills.

Buy it if you want one machine to replace a vacuum and mop. Skip it if you want a light steam mop.
products.skipIf: You want a light steam mop.

products.name: BISSELL PowerFresh Pet Steam Mop 19404 Hard Floor Steamer
products.verdict: Two steam levels, an Easy Scrubber and scent discs for pet households.
products.description:
The PowerFresh Pet 19404 has two steam levels, an Easy Scrubber for tough messes, and sanitising claims, and it uses scent discs to eliminate odours. It costs $50 to $100.

It is the pet-minded classic. Two settings are less refined than a full variable dial but still give you a choice. It ranks sixth because the scent disc approach masks smells instead of removing them, and not every floor warrants steam.

Buy it if you have pets on sealed hard floors. Skip it if you want a finer steam dial.
products.idealFor: Pet owners with sealed hard floors.
products.skipIf: You want a finer steam dial.

products.name: BISSELL Steam Mop 1940A PowerFresh Floor Steam Cleaner
products.verdict: A proven budget BISSELL with variable steam, an Easy Scrubber and a 12 inch path.
products.description:
The 1940A offers variable steam, an Easy Scrubber and a 12 inch cleaning path. It costs $50 to $100.

It is the cheapest way into the brand's classic steam line, and the variable dial is rare at this price. It ranks last only because the newer models add features the 1940A lacks, such as a faster warm-up or a vacuum.

Buy it if you want proven BISSELL reliability on a budget. Skip it if you want extras.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers wanting a proven steam mop.
products.skipIf: You want a vacuum or handheld.

whatMatters.detail: Classic PowerFresh models only steam. Vac and Steam units add debris pickup, 3-in-1 units add a handheld, and CrossWave adds wet-dry pickup. Choose by the chores you want to remove from your routine.
Variable or multi-level steam lets you adjust for tile, sealed wood and laminate. More levels give finer control. Check the listing for the number of levels.
Steam is meant for sealed hard floors only. Check your floor maker's guidance, especially for hardwood and laminate. Never steam unsealed or damaged boards.
Steam mops use washable pads, and some models use scent discs or filters. Check the cost and availability of replacements. BISSELL's wide supply is an advantage.
Combo units are heavier and bulkier than classic mops. Think about stairs and storage space. Slim bodies fit under furniture.

faq.q: Which BISSELL steam mop is best for hardwood?
faq.a: For sealed hardwood, the Deluxe 1806 offers the most steam control. Confirm your floor maker allows steam first.
Choosing by price rather than type. A classic mop and a vacuum combo solve different problems.

faq.q: Is the Vac and Steam worth it over a classic mop?
faq.a: If you want to skip sweeping, yes. If you already own a good vacuum, a classic mop saves money and weight.
Fill the tank, attach a pad, plug in and wait for steam. Combo units add a quick debris tank step.

faq.q: How do I descale a BISSELL steam mop?
faq.a: Empty the tank after use and follow the maker's guidance. Use distilled water if your tap water is hard.
No. They freshen the air but do not remove odours at the source. Cleaning the floor thoroughly does that.

finalTake: For most homes, the BISSELL PowerFresh Vac & Steam 2747A is the best BISSELL steam mop: it picks up debris and steams in one pass. The PowerFresh Slim 3-in-1 is the pick for handheld jobs, and the Deluxe 1806 offers the most control. If you only want to mop, the 1940A keeps costs low. Choose by routine, not price.
